sound-inventory.title: Sound inventory
sound-inventory.description: The consonants, vowels and other sounds the language uses, kept as the project's phonemes.

natural-classes.title: Natural classes
natural-classes.description: Groups of sounds that behave alike, such as the vowels or the voiceless stops, that rules and conditions refer to.

phonological-rules.title: Phonological rules
phonological-rules.description: Rules that say how a sound changes next to other sounds, and the environments that state where.

compounding.title: Compounding
compounding.description: Words built by joining two stems, and the rules FieldWorks uses to allow it.

conditioned-allomorphy.title: Conditioned allomorphy
conditioned-allomorphy.description: Which form of a morpheme appears where, decided by the sounds around it or by what it attaches to.

affix-slots-and-templates.title: Affix slots and templates
affix-slots-and-templates.description: The ordered positions on a word where affixes attach, and the templates that arrange them for a category.

inflection-features.title: Inflection features
inflection-features.description: Grammatical features such as number or tense, their values, and the feature structures that carry them.

noun-class-and-gender.title: Noun class and gender
noun-class-and-gender.description: The classes that sort nouns, which agreement and affixes may depend on.

inflection-classes.title: Inflection classes
inflection-classes.description: Groups of words that inflect the same way, and which classes an affix or a stem belongs to.

stem-alternation.title: Stem alternation
stem-alternation.description: Stems that take different shapes in different grammatical contexts, and the stem names that pick among them.

lexical-entries-and-glosses.title: Lexical entries and glosses
lexical-entries-and-glosses.description: Dictionary entries with their forms, alternate forms and short glosses.

senses-and-definitions.title: Senses and definitions
senses-and-definitions.description: The meanings of an entry, each with a gloss and a fuller definition.

texts-and-analyses.title: Texts and analyses
texts-and-analyses.description: Interlinear texts, and the decisions that approve or reject how each word is analysed.

parsimony-dispositions.title: Parsimony dispositions
parsimony-dispositions.description: A recorded decision to keep, fix, ask about or defer a finding that points to a possible simplification of the grammar.

infixation.title: Infixation
infixation.description: Affixes that are inserted inside a root or stem rather than before or after it, authored as an affix process with a stem pattern and an insertion.

reduplication.title: Reduplication
reduplication.description: Marking a meaning by copying all or part of a stem, authored as an affix process whose output copies parts of the stem.

example-sentences.title: Example sentences
example-sentences.description: Sentences that illustrate how a word or sense is used; Motif has no Composer for them yet.

grammar-explanation.title: Grammar explanation
grammar-explanation.description: Prose that describes or explains the grammar, such as the paragraphs of a grammar sketch; Motif has no Composer for it yet.

outside-authoring.title: Outside Motif's authoring
outside-authoring.description: Requests that are not grammar or lexicon authoring, or that no Composer models: exports, imports, printouts, counts and reports, recordings, and tone rules that act across words.
